candidates.kp-280m: shipped bc977796e2002e8ab045664618ed8372781896bd; independent training seed unknown; NOT KLU-106 v2

protocol.operator: KP and stock Presidio: local literal U+2588 replacement over union of native detector character offsets, no whitespace-token expansion, no eval-label filtering. Shield: native DEFAULT replace; retain HTTP receipts and all native types.
protocol.scope: Frozen detector-plus-operator experiments. KP/stock masks are new local operators, not deployed gateway implementations. Existing test gold, not a new independent gateway challenge.
protocol.utility: fraction of gold non-PII non-whitespace characters removed; retention = 1 - fraction; zero denominator unavailable
protocol.legacy: TAB any-overlap DIRECT/QUASI; national-ID and name-in-context on remaining configs, with unavailable denominators explicit
protocol.best_tab_seed: descriptive highest test F1; label post-hoc, never use alone for acceptance; report every seed and spread
protocol.win_gate: gateway-contract v1: each of >=3 candidate seeds has v2 Wilson upper < comparator lower AND paired cluster delta upper < 0 AND over-redaction delta upper <= 0; preserve legacy RO/PL zero floors; reviewed held-out/disjointness and language support gates apply
protocol.ties: zero/zero legacy national-ID floor is tie; overlapping CIs are no established superiority, not statistical equivalence
protocol.missing: unverified, never zero or pass; persist exceptions per config/model
protocol.training: TAB missing checkpoints: repeat registered RES-104 recipe sequentially, batch16 fp32 MPS, prior runtime 923 seconds/seed (<2h). Shipped 280M independent same-recipe seed checkpoints unavailable; do not relabel v2 models as shipped-model seeds.
